description: Extract an Epic domain layer (aggregate root, typed status/priority, transitions, events) from EpicGrain, preserving all observable behavior; thin the grain to load→call→persist and make EpicProgress a pure typed projection.

tasks.title: Extract Epic domain layer (aggregate root, typed status/priority, transitions, events, relocated exceptions)
tasks.description: Create the `Epic/Domain/` layer mirroring `Issue/Domain/`: an `Epic` aggregate root (partial, private state + PendingEvents/RecordEvent) that owns its linked-issue set; `Epic.Transitions.cs` where each transition (Create/Update/MarkDone/Close/LinkIssue/UnlinkIssue) is precondition guard + state change + event; `EpicStatus` enum (Active/Done/Closed) and `EpicPriority` value object (From/Default) replacing magic strings; `Events/EpicEvent.cs` union + per-event records; relocate `EpicLifecycleExceptions.cs` from `Grains/` to `Domain/`. Scope is Active/Done/Closed only — Pause/Resume are #173 and excluded.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Epic/Domain/` exists with Epic.cs (partial aggregate root), Epic.Transitions.cs, EpicStatus.cs, EpicPriority.cs, Events/EpicEvent.cs, and EpicLifecycleExceptions.cs (moved from Grains/).
No magic status strings (`active`/`done`/`closed`) or priority strings (`p0`..`p4`) remain in domain code — they are replaced by `EpicStatus` and `EpicPriority`.

Every transition method = precondition guard + state change + `RecordEvent`; `MarkDone(IReadOnlySet<int> undeliveredLinkedNumbers)` throws `EpicNotReadyToMarkDoneException` when the epic is non-terminal and the undelivered set is non-empty; terminal refusal throws `EpicAlreadyTerminalException`.
`Close()` records `EpicClosed`; `LinkIssue` rejects a duplicate link inside the aggregate (invariant I3); the domain layer has no `IDbContextFactory`/IO dependency (pure).

Unit tests on `Epic.Transitions` cover: terminal refusal → EpicAlreadyTerminalException, mark-done guard (ready passes / blocked throws with correct count), duplicate link rejection, and Close records EpicClosed. `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` for the server project pass.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Epic/Domain/ (Epic.cs, Epic.Transitions.cs, EpicStatus.cs, EpicPriority.cs, Events/EpicEvent.cs, EpicLifecycleExceptions.cs) + domain unit tests
tasks.notes: Mirror Issue/Domain/ exactly: Issue.cs (partial + RecordEvent/PendingEvents/ClearPendingEvents), Issue.Transitions.cs (guard+change+event per method), IssueStatus enum, IssuePriority record struct, Events/IssueEvent.cs (`public union ...`). Reuse the same union source generator as IssueEvent; if unavailable, confirm wiring first. MarkDone follows the Issue.Start(undeliveredPrerequisites) pattern — external state passed in, domain stays IO-free. Completion judgment (link completed = issue status done|completed, health ignored) stays the single source in EpicProgress, consumed by the grain in T-002.

tasks.title: Thin EpicGrain to load→call domain→persist and make EpicProgress a pure typed projection
tasks.description: Adapt the application layer onto the new domain: rewrite `EpicGrain` so each command loads `EpicRow` + its `EpicIssueRow` set, materializes the `Epic` aggregate, calls the domain transition, then maps state back and persists — with the close→unlink-all side effect driven by draining `PendingEvents` and removing links when `EpicClosed` is seen. Refactor `EpicProgress` so `IsTerminal`/`IsCompleted` are built on the typed model. Delete the now-dead grain logic.
acceptanceCriteria: `EpicGrain` contains no inline business rules: the private `IsReadyToMarkDoneAsync`/`CountUndeliveredAsync` helpers and the inline string-based terminal/ready/close branches are removed; each command body is load EpicRow+EpicIssueRow → materialize Epic → call domain transition → map back → persist.

The close→unlink-all side effect is driven by the `EpicClosed` event: on save, the grain drains `PendingEvents` and, when `EpicClosed` is present, removes the epic's `EpicIssueRow` rows (observable result identical to pre-refactor close).

`EpicProgress.IsTerminal` is built on `EpicStatus` (typed) rather than a string list; `IsCompleted` semantics are unchanged (issue status done|completed, health ignored); `Build` is the single completion source reused by both the read path and the grain's undelivered-set computation.

Behavior-preserving: existing Epic tests, including `EpicApiSpecs`, pass unchanged — create / link / unlink / mark-done (blocked then ready) / close (links removed) / update produce the same observable results, exceptions, and side effects as before.
No DTO, API route, API contract, or persistence-schema changes; `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` for the server project are green.
tasks.output: Refactored packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Epic/Grains/EpicGrain.cs (thinned) and Epic/Services/EpicProgress.cs (typed projection); existing EpicApiSpecs + Epic tests green
tasks.notes: Epic stays on IDbContextFactory/EpicRow persistence — do NOT adopt IssueGrain's IStateStore<T> or event store (Non-Goal: no event sourcing / persistence redesign). Only EpicClosed carries a persistence side effect (unlink); other pending events are recorded and drained but not published to a bus in this issue. Cross-epic uniqueness (I4) stays a grain-level DB query — #179 owns its refinement. Keep EpicRow/EpicIssueRow string columns; mapping to/from typed values happens at grain load/save boundaries.
